checkpoint_finding.reason: There is no source revision, architecture, tokenizer, graph transform, decoder, runtime, or fitted artifact to audit.

held_source_feasibility.future_feasible_design: Remove the evaluated source before node, token, mask, position, and graph construction; train a generic candidate-gene scorer on remaining sources; join evaluator-only source labels after prediction freeze.
held_source_feasibility.relation_specific_failure: A held-source token, type embedding, query, or decoder has no training signal after complete source removal and cannot define a valid unseen-source score.
held_source_feasibility.seal_status: No current evidence source is sealed, so even a future leakage-safe leave-source-out score remains development-only.

known_leakage_routes: Selecting a published graph-transformer implementation after observing project source-recovery results, then retaining the same model ID.
Tokenizing nodes, edges, types, candidates, or source coverage from the complete graph before removal.
Fitting graph-wide self-attention masks, positional encodings, Laplacian features, random-walk features, shortest paths, centrality, metapaths, normalization, or vocabulary on held-source topology.
Retaining held-source IDs, type embeddings, inverse edges, source nodes, aliases, observability, tested status, missingness, prevalence, degree, source count, or deterministic derivatives.
Using a held-source-specific head or a randomly initialized unseen source embedding.
Treating missing, untestable, not-applicable, unavailable, indeterminate, or absent evidence as a negative or zero token.
Using current Gene Catalog memberships, provisional COLOC outcomes, frozen 117 programs, or hero genes as design or selection targets.
Importing an external knowledge graph without a source-level outcome and alias audit.
Interpreting attention values as causal importance or counting tokens, heads, seeds, genes, variants, cells, or guides as independent replicates.

license_disposition.project_weights: not_created; future redistribution requires implementation terms and all graph-source derivative rights

remaining_blockers: Choose and freeze one exact implementation identity before writing or comparing code: repository, immutable revision, package, paper mapping, complete architecture, source license, and redistribution terms.
Complete and promote the corrected 50-study COLOC release, then freeze one graph snapshot, evidence ontology, canonical node universe, source aliases, LD and locus groups, and provenance.

Freeze tokenization, canonical order, type and inverse encoding, source-independent node features, continuous values, missingness masks, attention scope, positional features, generic decoder, negatives, calibration, optimizer, early stopping, and five seeds.
Choose and verify inductive behavior. A model with entity-ID or fixed graph-token embeddings is transductive and cannot claim unseen-node transfer.
Implement source removal before every vocabulary, token, mask, positional, graph, feature, negative, normalization, and sampling operation.

Create synthetic fixtures that reject source-only nodes, inverse and alias leakage, untestable negatives, held-source tokens, untrained relation outputs, metadata permutations, and query-time graph refitting.
Define tensor-only save and strict-load receipts, then freeze graph, training, environment, model, calibration, and prediction hashes for each split and seed.
Only after campaign approval, run implementation-specific import, forward/backward, local fit, save/resume, deterministic-seed, CPU/L40S tolerance, and metric-reproduction probes through SLURM.
Keep the track blocked and development-only until a wholly sealed evidence source is prospectively registered and powered.
